cards.need: The corrupt governor has ordered his thugs to destroy the physical vote backups before the recount.
cards.stakes: If I cannot secure the original ballots, the dictator will steal the election and begin his purges.
cards.board_text: They are burning the tally stations! The governor knows he lost the vote, and his men are destroying the physical records. I managed to gather the raw datachits, but I need a sealed ballot cache to lock them away where his override codes cannot reach them. Help me save this democracy before the violence starts.

cards.need: The vote for the new cafeteria menu was a tie, and I refuse to let the opposing faction win the rights to Taco Tuesday.
cards.stakes: If the ballots are compromised, we will be subjected to boiled nutrient paste for another month.
cards.board_text: The cafeteria union vote has devolved into total anarchy! Half the guild wants tacos, and the other half wants synthesized gruel. I have the tie-breaking ballots, and I do not trust the other side not to tamper with them. I need a sealed ballot cache to lock these votes down. The culinary future of this station is at stake!

cards.need: My family is tearing itself apart over who will lead when I step down, and we must hold a secret, unhackable vote.
cards.stakes: Without a secure way to count the choices, the clan will fracture into a bitter feud.
cards.board_text: My children are arguing over the inheritance, and the bickering is destroying our family. I have decided to let the whole clan vote on the new leader, but I know my eldest will try to slice the digital tallies. I need a sealed ballot cache, the old-fashioned physical kind. Only a locked box can give us a fair answer and keep the peace.
